knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## load packages

```{r}
library(dplyr) # v.1.2.1
library(tidyr) # v.1.3.1
library(here) # v.1.0.1
library(psych) # v.2.4.6.26

```

## EEG behavior analysis

```{r}
load(here("Data", "df_full_EEG.Rda"))

df_full <- df_full %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorr = mean(accuracy))

df_agg_overall <- df_full %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt = mean(as.numeric(response_time), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
  filter(accuracy < .75)

subs2exclude  <- df_agg_overall$participant_id

df_agg <- df_full %>%
  group_by(participant_id, trial_type, task_set) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt = mean(as.numeric(response_time), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_wide_EEG <- df_agg %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(trial_type, task_set),
    values_from = c(accuracy, rt),
    names_sep = "_"
  )


df_filtered_EEG <- df_wide_EEG[!df_wide_EEG$participant_id %in% subs2exclude, ]

summary_EEG <-df_filtered_EEG %>%
  describe()


```

## MRI behavior analysis

```{r}
load(here("Data", "df_full_MRI.Rda"))

df_full <- df_full %>% group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(PropCorr = mean(accuracy))

df_agg_overall <- df_full %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt = mean(as.numeric(response_time), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
  filter(accuracy < .75) # 24 around chance level 

subs2exclude  <- df_agg_overall$participant_id

df_agg <- df_full %>%
  group_by(participant_id, trial_type, task_set) %>%
  summarise(
    accuracy = mean(accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    rt = mean(as.numeric(response_time), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_wide <- df_agg %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(trial_type, task_set),
    values_from = c(accuracy, rt),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

df_filtered <- df_wide[!df_wide$participant_id %in% subs2exclude, ]

summary <-df_filtered %>%
  describe()
```
